notes: Site profile: the recipe at tp4-ring on the stock 4 KiB kernel (7.0.0-1025-nvidia, no memory saver), with control traffic on the ring0 node addresses (10.10.100.x) because the nodes have no wired management network. Start it with --unqualified-shape. It keeps the recipe's GLP block: the steered name deepseek-v4.1-flash-weightless is served beside the stock name on nodes holding the pinned vector (its repository is gated; accept its agreement on the downloading account). It uses the promoted upstream lock: the 1126 patch heads reproduce on this host.
